profile.name: Kevin Wang
profile.title: Senior Backend / Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Backend and systems engineer with 13+ years of experience building production software across messaging, integrations, data-heavy workflows, cloud operations, and AI-assisted delivery.
profile.tagline: I build backend systems that stay boring in production.
profile.availability: Open to remote Senior Backend / Systems roles

experience.summary: Own and evolve production backend systems spanning integrations, messaging, operational tooling, and reliability.
highlights: Operate a notification platform delivering 1M+ push notifications and 50K+ SMS messages per day.
Integrated five SMS providers with configurable routing, retry, failure handling, and delivery-state tracking.
Maintain C#/.NET and SQL Server services on Azure and IIS, with production monitoring through Application Insights.
Improved user-facing performance with caching and AJAX lazy loading while guarding against race conditions with server-side revalidation.

experience.summary: Built and maintained a multi-school budgeting and accounting system with reporting, cross-school queries, and complex business rules.
highlights: Worked on .NET 4.8 / SQL Server production systems deployed across multiple servers.
Optimized indexing, large queries, and overnight reporting workloads.
Implemented priority-based and EAV-style business logic for evolving budgeting requirements.
Supported procurement, acceptance, and finance workflows used across schools.

experience.summary: Worked on retail data integration and incentive-calculation pipelines.
highlights: Built Oracle-to-SQL Server ETL flows with SSIS.
Processed high-volume monthly store data and multi-level bonus calculations.
Implemented stored-procedure-driven transformation and calculation workflows.
